title: Numerically Stable Cholesky-QR on GPU via Mixed-Precision Randomized Preconditioning
summary: Cholesky-QR is among the fastest algorithms for computing the thin QR factorization of tall-and-skinny matrices on GPUs, relying entirely on BLAS-3 operations. However, it is numerically unstable: forming the Gram matrix squares the condition number, causing breakdown when $κ_2(\boldsymbol{A}) \gtrsim 10^8$. We present MRCQR (Mixed-Precision Randomized Cholesky-QR), a stable GPU algorithm that addresses this limitation.
